name: com.agenerela.sdcpp
description: Runs an image model inside Unity, with no server: an IImageProvider for Agenerela that calls stable-diffusion.cpp in-process to make and edit pictures with models such as Z-Image Turbo. The native library and the model files are downloaded on the developer's choice and never ship inside the package.

samples.description: Makes a portrait at a key press, edits it, and shows both, with the seconds each took.
